request.reason: Independent review of the passed 27-node local run found that MCP plan-only and persisted formal attempt commands still project the obsolete 300-second implicit package deadline, and CLI mixed-deadline aggregation can report a misleading top-level timeout. Extend only the necessary existing protocol projection and focused regression files; retain the prior passing and failed receipts, the 600/300 execution policy, and all hosted acceptance gates.

changes.value: MCP plan-only, persisted formal attempt command metadata and CLI aggregate receipt must report deadlines consistent with planned and executed package/non-package nodes: implicit cargo test --package is 600 seconds, other implicit commands 300 seconds, and a mixed receipt must not present a smaller timeout as its overall execution bound. Focused negative-to-positive regression and a fresh source-bound formal verification are required; old attempts remain immutable.

acceptanceCriteria: 无显式 CARGO_TARGET_DIR 时，Cargo 验证默认 target 由当前规范化 checkout 路径稳定派生；两个 linked worktree 不共享构建产物，显式 caller target 仍优先，不能引用已归档 worktree 路径。回归覆盖测试二进制 CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR 路径绑定。
无显式 timeout 的 cargo test --package 节点使用有限 600 秒默认，其他命令继续 300 秒；显式 timeout 仍须通过现有 Contract/项目政策上限且不超过 900 秒。执行、计划、失败与超时收据如实记录，不能跳过或复用未通过测试。
先补准确 RED 负例，再做最小 GREEN；格式、Clippy、完整 cargo test --locked --workspace、针对性执行器回归、当前候选 Runtime 的正式验证以及 PR 精确头 CI 均真实通过，保持 13 个 workspace package 完整覆盖。
保留 WI-1065 的两次失败 attempt；本修复合并并更新本地 Runtime 后，在 WI-1065 原 Contract 与专属工作区重新取得正式验证、PR CI 与后续收尾证据，不把本 WI 的绿灯冒充认知评估交付。

CLI plan-only regression must display the same finite 600-second implicit package-test deadline as the Runtime planner while non-package requests retain 300 seconds; MCP public schema and English/Japanese/Chinese command and capability references must describe these actual defaults without implying that an explicit override bypasses policy.
previousContract.goal: 使不同 linked worktree 的默认 Cargo 构建产物互不污染，并让真实耗时超过五分钟的完整 package 测试在有限 600 秒边界内执行；保留其他命令 300 秒默认与显式覆盖的政策约束。
previousContract.intent: 修复当前 Task9 交付中真实暴露的 Runtime Cargo 验证环境隔离与有界时限摩擦，不降低测试覆盖或证据要求。

scenarioCoverage.expected: The same repository in distinct linked worktrees gets distinct deterministic default Cargo target directories, preventing test binaries from retaining the other checkout's CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR; an explicit caller target remains unchanged.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: RED-to-GREEN repository execution-context regression and an actual two-checkout Cargo test-binary path probe; verify the default path is canonical-checkout-derived and explicit CARGO_TARGET_DIR wins.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Only implicit cargo test --package nodes default to 600 seconds; all other implicit commands remain at 300 seconds. Explicit timeouts still require existing project policy, remain at or below 900 seconds, and bounded timeout failures are persisted honestly.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: RED-to-GREEN plan/execution regression for package and non-package commands, explicit allowed and rejected overrides, and timeout receipt behavior; run the full declared Runtime verification without skipping a package.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The candidate Runtime completes all 13 workspace packages, fmt and Clippy with source-bound receipts; exact-head PR CI retains contract-aware producer, gate, and coverage checks without treating WI-1065's old failed attempts as passed.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Before finish, run focused tests and the full declared Runtime verification on the frozen current source; inspect its receipt for all 13 workspace packages, fmt, Clippy, source identity, and no skipped or reused failed package. After archive, inspect real exact-head PR CI route, formal receipt or archived read-only lane as applicable, Rust gate, repository gates and workspace coverage before merge; after installation, reverify WI-1065 separately. Local evidence never stands in for hosted PR acceptance.
